title: Correspondence edge
description: A typed edge between two nodes (cells, map nodes, toolkit cards or whole fields). The edge records what maps to what, when the link holds and where it breaks.

id.description: Stable ID (R12). Never reused; retire instead.

source.description: Node the technique or result comes from. A cell ID (PH.O.A1.1), a map node (MSC:11Gxx), a toolkit card (MA.TK.42) or a field code (PH).

target.description: Node the technique or result is carried to. Same forms as source.

directed.description: True when the edge runs from source to target only.

mapping.description: Which object maps to which, which method to which, which warrant to which. Empty lists mean not yet recorded.

holds_under.description: Conditions under which the link holds.

status.description: asserted = stated in the pyramid text without a proved / programme / conjectured label.

status_note.description: The source's own wording of the status, where it has one.

name.description: Name of the correspondence, where the source names it.

group.description: Shared by edges split from one multi-cell correspondence.
